adjudication_basis: Every verdict independently re-checked against the pinned source. SCOUT output was context only. D1 blight.lua getter lines were wrong (124/125 -> 127/128/129); D2 cited induced-phenomena and both info blocks exactly but drifted on npcs.lua getters (getDuration 138 -> 141, range 2631 -> 2634).

items.source: 15% chance to animate a bleeding foe's blood
items.target: 15%几率活化流血敌人的血液
items.source_evidence: world-artifacts-far-east.lua:222 BLOODEDGE; special_on_hit fct gated by rng.percent(15) then requires a target tmp effect with subtype.cut
items.note: 15% and the bleed precondition both match; no placeholder.

items.source: Try to fry your enemies brain (25% chance to brainlock)
items.target: 试图封锁敌人的大脑（25%几率思维封锁）
items.source_evidence: world-artifacts.lua:3139 Focus Whip; special_on_crit fct rng.percent(25) then crossTierEffect(EFF_BRAINLOCKED)
items.note: Mechanically correct. Flavour drift only: 'fry ... brain' rendered as 封锁 (lock), which pre-empts the effect name instead of the burn image. Not a mechanism error.

items.source: The target is infected with a corrosive worm, reducing blight and acid resistance by %d%%. When the effect ends, the worm will explode, dealing %d acid damage in a 4 radius ball. This damage will increase by %d%% of all damage taken while under torment
items.target: 目标被腐蚀蠕虫感染，减少 %d%% 酸性和枯萎抗性，效果结束后，蠕虫团将爆炸，在半径 4 范围内造成 %d 酸性伤害。在该效果下受到伤害的 %d%% 将被加成至爆炸伤害中。
items.source_evidence: magical.lua:1282 CORROSIVE_WORM long_desc tformat(eff.power, eff.finaldam, eff.rate*100); resists BLIGHT/ACID = -power (activate); ball radius=4 hardcoded (deactivate); blight.lua:139 setEffect dur 6, getResist:127, getPercent:128, getDamage:129
items.note: Placeholder order and all three dimensions match. Resistance listing order differs from English (酸性和枯萎 vs blight and acid) but both take the same -power, so no meaning change.

items.source: Improves/gives invisibility (power %d), and increases damage dealt to blind or dazzled creatures by %d%%.
items.target: 提升或获得隐形（强度 %d），对致盲或炫目目标造成的伤害提高 %d%%。
items.source_evidence: magical.lua:257 GREATER_INVISIBILITY long_desc tformat(eff.power, eff.dam)
items.note: Both placeholders bound in the same order; blind/dazzled condition preserved.

items.source: The target is cursed, reducing all damage done by %d%%.
items.target: 目标被诅咒，所有伤害降低 %d%%。
items.source_evidence: magical.lua:949 CURSE_IMPOTENCE, status='detrimental'; activate: addTemporaryValue('inc_damage', {all = -eff.power})
items.note: Source 'all damage done' means damage the cursed actor DEALS: inc_damage is the bearer's outgoing damage modifier. The target text drops 造成的, so 所有伤害降低 reads most naturally as incoming damage reduced, i.e. a benefit, inverting a detrimental curse.
items.proposed_target: 目标被诅咒，造成的所有伤害降低 %d%%。

items.source: Increases physical power, physical save, spellpower, spell save, mindpower, and mental save by %d.
items.target: 提高你 %d 点物理强度、物理豁免、法术强度、法术豁免、精神强度和精神豁免。
items.source_evidence: other.lua:766 MILITANT_MIND; activate adds combat_dam, combat_spellpower, combat_mindpower, combat_physresist, combat_spellresist, combat_mentalresist, each = eff.power, all on self (the effect bearer)
items.note: All six stats and their order match. Advisory only: the target adds 你, which is absent from the source; the same tooltip renders for NPC bearers, where 你 is inaccurate.

items.source: The target's skin reacts to damage, granting %d armour.
items.target: 目标皮肤抵抗伤害，提升 %d 护甲值。
items.source_evidence: physical.lua:678 STONE_SKIN; activate addTemporaryValue('combat_armor', eff.power)
items.note: Numeric payload (armour) correct. Advisory only: 'reacts to damage' rendered as 抵抗伤害 (resists), a flavour shift; the armour grant itself is stated correctly.

items.source: Parrying melee attacks: Has a %d%% chance to deflect up to %d damage from the next %0.1f attack(s).
items.target: 格挡近战攻击：有 %d%% 几率偏转接下来攻击中至多 %d 点伤害（剩余 %0.1f 次）。
items.source_evidence: Batch source matches physical.lua:2228 EFF_DUAL_WEAPON_DEFENSE long_desc, not the live physical.lua:2251 EFF_PARRY (whose string adds a %s for ' and ranged' and a 'Parried attacks cannot crit.' sentence). Repo-wide and DLC-wide grep finds no setEffect for EFF_DUAL_WEAPON_DEFENSE; only removeEffect at physical.lua:523 and other.lua:2749.
items.note: The string is never displayed: the effect is never applied anywhere in the engine or the three DLCs. Translation itself binds the three placeholders in the correct order. No change proposed; excluded from defect counts.

items.source: Teleports up to five targets in a radius of %d up to ten tiles away.
items.target: 将半径 %d 范围内最多五个单位传送到十格外。
items.source_evidence: anomalies.lua:155 info tformat(radius), single placeholder; doAction line 144 calls a:teleportRandom(a.x, a.y, 10, 1); Actor.lua:1631 signature teleportRandom(x, y, dist, min_dist) so 10 is the MAXIMUM distance and 1 the minimum
items.note: Source 'up to ten tiles away' states a ceiling. The target renders it as 十格外, which reads as 'beyond ten tiles', turning a maximum displacement into a minimum one. Radius placeholder itself is bound correctly, and 最多五个单位 matches rng.avg(1,5,3).
items.proposed_target: 将半径 %d 范围内最多五个单位随机传送到十格以内。

items.source: Each turn, for the next %d turns, one of the target's sustained talents will be deactivated.
items.target: 接下来 %d 回合中，每回合解除目标的随机一个持续性技能。
items.source_evidence: energy.lua:176 getDuration = getExtensionModifier(combatTalentScale(t,1,7) floored); EFF_ENTROPY magical.lua:3763 on_timeout calls removeSustainsFilter(eff.src, nil, 1); Actor.lua:7233 -> sustainsFilter ends in rng.tableSample(ids, nb)
items.note: Duration placeholder correct. The target adds 随机, which the English 'one of' leaves implicit; rng.tableSample confirms the selection really is random, so the addition is accurate rather than invented.

items.source:
Improves your capacity to see invisible foes by +%d and to see through stealth by +%d.  Additionally you have a %d%% chance to recover from a single negative status effect each turn.
		Sense abilities will scale with your Magic stat.
items.target:
增强你的隐形侦测能力 +%d 以及潜行侦测能力 +%d。  此外，每回合你有 %d%% 的几率从一个负面状态中回复。
		受魔法属性影响，侦测能力按比例增加。
items.source_evidence: guardian.lua:149-155 info tformat(sense, sense, power); getSense:131 combatTalentStatDamage(t,'mag',10,50); getPower:132 combatTalentLimit(t,40,10,30)
items.note: Both +%d placeholders receive the same getSense value, so the two sense figures are identical by construction; the target keeps them separate in the same order. Magic-stat scaling clause matches the 'mag' argument.

items.source:
Reverses the polarity of your Cosmic Cycle.  If it's currently contracting, it will begin to expand, firing a homing missile at each target within the radius that deals %0.2f temporal damage.
		If it's currently expanding, it will begin to contract, braiding the lifelines of all targets within the radius for %d turns.  Braided targets take %d%% of all damage dealt to other braided targets.
		The damage will scale with your Spellpower.
items.target:
逆转你宇宙圈的极性。如果它正在收缩，它将开始膨胀，向半径范围内的每个目标发射一枚瞄准的飞弹，造成 %0.2f 时空伤害。
		如果它目前正在扩张，它将开始收缩，将半径范围内所有目标的生命线编织 %d 回合。被编织目标承受对其他编织目标造成的所有伤害的 %d%%。
		伤害受法术强度加成。
items.source_evidence: induced-phenomena.lua:221-228 info tformat(damDesc(TEMPORAL, damage), duration, braid); getDamage:164, getBraid:165, getDuration:166
items.note: All three placeholders bound in the right order, with damage passed through damDesc. Advisory only: the same Cosmic Cycle state is rendered 膨胀 in the first clause and 扩张 in the second within one string; the source uses expand/expanding throughout. Terminology consistency, not a mechanism error.

items.source: Releases stinging spores at the target, blinding it for %d turns.
items.target: 向目标喷射孢子，使目标致盲 %d 回合。
items.source_evidence: npcs.lua:141 getDuration = floor(combatTalentScale(t,6,10)); line 151 setEffect(EFF_BLINDED, t.getDuration(...)); info line 161 tformat(t.getDuration(...))
items.note: The displayed duration is the same getter the action applies. Advisory only: 'stinging' is dropped from the target; purely descriptive, no mechanical content.

items.source:
Use your telekinetic power to enhance your strength, allowing you to pick up an adjacent enemy and hurl it anywhere within radius %d.
		Upon landing, your target takes %0.1f Physical damage and is stunned for 4 turns.  All other creatures within radius 2 of the landing point take %0.1f Physical damage and are knocked away from you.
		This talent ignores %d%% of the knockback resistance of the thrown target, which takes half damage if it resists being thrown.
		The damage improves with your Mindpower and the range increases with both Mindpower and Strength.
items.target:
运用念动力强化你的力量，抓起一名相邻敌人，将其投掷到半径 %d 内的任意位置。
		落地时，目标受到 %0.1f 点物理伤害并被震慑 4 回合。落点半径 2 格内的其他生物受到 %0.1f 点物理伤害，并被击退至远离你的方向。
		该技能忽略被投掷目标 %d%% 的击退抵抗；如果目标抵抗了投掷，则只受到一半伤害。
		伤害受精神强度加成，投掷范围受精神强度和力量加成。
items.source_evidence: npcs.lua:2676-2683 info tformat(range, dam, dam/2, t.getKBResistPen(self,t)); range:2634 floor(combatStatScale('str',1,5)+combatMindpower()/20); getDamage:2635 floor(combatTalentMindDamage(t,10,170)); getKBResistPen:2638 combatTalentLimit(t,100,25,45)
items.note: Four placeholders in correct order, including the halved AOE figure as the third argument. The hardcoded 4-turn stun and radius 2 are preserved as literals, and both scaling clauses match the actual helpers (mind damage; strength plus mindpower for range).

items.source:
You bind light in a glyph on the floor. All enemies walking over the glyph will be dazed for %d turns.
		The glyph is a hidden trap (%d detection and %d disarm power based on your Magic) and lasts for %d turns.
items.target:
你用光能在地上刻画圣印。所有经过的目标会被眩晕 %d 回合。
		圣印视为隐藏陷阱（%d 侦查强度，%d 点解除强度，基于魔法）持续 %d 回合。
items.source_evidence: celestial/other.lua:176-181 info tformat(dazeduration, t.trapPower*0.8, t.trapPower, duration); getDazeDuration:123, getDuration:124, trapPower:125; canTrigger gates on who:reactionToward(self.summoner) < 0, so only hostiles trigger the glyph
items.note: All four placeholders bound in the right order, including the asymmetry that detection is trapPower*0.8 while disarm is the full trapPower. Defect is scope: the source says 'All enemies', the target says 所有经过的目标, dropping the hostile-only restriction that canTrigger enforces. 眩晕 for dazed is consistent with corpus usage, with 震慑 reserved for stun per terminology/combat.tsv:40.
items.proposed_target:
你用光能在地上刻画圣印。所有经过的敌人会被眩晕 %d 回合。
		圣印视为隐藏陷阱（%d 侦查强度，%d 点解除强度，基于魔法）持续 %d 回合。

items.source: Your grappling hook is tipped with vicious, venomous barbs. Creatures struck by it will be hit for %d%% unarmed damage, bleed for %0.2f physical damage and be poisoned for %0.2f nature damage over 4 turns.
items.target: 你的钩爪上涂有毒素且装有尖刺，被击中的生物受到 %d%% 徒手伤害 ,在 4 回合内受到 %0.2f 流血伤害和 %0.2f 自然毒素伤害。
items.source_evidence: cunning/artifice.lua:818-821 info tformat(t.getDamage*100, damDesc(PHYSICAL, getSecondaryDamage), damDesc(NATURE, getSecondaryDamage)); both DoT figures come from the same getter at :814; application at :757-758 uses setEffect(EFF_CUT/EFF_POISONED, 4, {power=dam2/4}), so the displayed figure is the 4-turn total
items.note: Mechanically correct: placeholder order right, and 在 4 回合内 correctly conveys a total rather than a per-turn figure. Defect is punctuation only: the target contains U+0020 followed by a half-width comma U+002C where Chinese body text requires the full-width form.
items.proposed_target: 你的钩爪上涂有毒素且装有尖刺，被击中的生物受到 %d%% 徒手伤害，在 4 回合内受到 %0.2f 流血伤害和 %0.2f 自然毒素伤害。

items.source:
A terrible gloom surrounds you, affecting all those who approach to within radius 3. At the end of each game turn, those caught in your gloom must save against your Mindpower, or have a %d%% chance to suffer from slowness (30%%), stun or confusion (30%%) for %d turns.
		The chance increases with your mind speed.
		This ability is innate, and carries no cost to activate or deactivate.
		Each point in Gloom talents increases your Mindpower (current total: %d).
items.target:
可怕的黑暗光环笼罩着你，影响进入半径 3 格内的所有生物。每个游戏回合结束时，光环内的生物必须以精神豁免对抗你的精神强度；若豁免失败，则有 %d%% 几率陷入减速（30%%）、震慑或混乱（30%%）状态，持续 %d 回合。
		几率随你的精神速度提高。
		这是与生俱来的能力，启用或停用均不消耗资源。
		黑暗光环系技能每投入 1 点，都会提高你的精神强度（当前总计：%d）。
items.source_evidence: cursed/gloom.lua:120-127 info tformat(chance, duration, mindpowerChange); getChance:43 capped at 25; getDuration:45-47 returns a fixed 3; the two literal 30%% correspond to real constants at :85 EFF_GLOOM_CONFUSED power=30 and :95 EFF_GLOOM_SLOW power=0.3; save check at :80 uses target:checkHit(mindpower, target:combatMentalResist(), ...)
items.note: Three formatted values in the right order with both hardcoded 30%% literals preserved in the correct clauses. The target's 以精神豁免 is verified against combatMentalResist and is more explicit than the English, which only says 'save against your Mindpower'.

items.source:
Meditate on your link with Nature.
		While meditating, your equilibrium decreases by %0.2f per turn, your Mental Save is increased by %d, and your healing factor increases by %d%%.
		Your deep meditation does not let you deal damage correctly, reducing the damage you and your summons deal by 50%%.
		Also, any time you are resting (even with Meditation not sustained) you enter a simple meditative state that decreases your equilibrium by %0.2f per turn.
		The activated effects increase with your Mindpower.
items.target:
你进入冥想，与大自然进行沟通。
		冥想时，你的失衡值每回合降低 %0.2f，精神豁免提高 %d，治疗系数提高 %d%%。
		深度冥想使你无法正常造成伤害，你和召唤物造成的伤害减少 50%%。
		另外，你在休息时（即使未维持冥想）会自动进入浅度冥想状态，使失衡值每回合降低 %0.2f。
		激活时效果受精神强度加成。
items.source_evidence: gifts/call.lua:76-88 info tformat(pt, save, heal, rest); pt derives from drain_equilibrium:34-37, rest from restingRegen:49 — two different getters; the 50%% damage reduction is hardcoded in the string, not formatted
items.note: Both %0.2f values are distinct getters and the target attaches each to the correct clause (sustained meditation versus resting). The literal 50%% is preserved, and the Mindpower scaling clause matches combatTalentMindDamage.

items.source:
Spit lightning on your foe, doing %d to %d damage.
		The damage will increase with your Willpower.
items.target:
向单体敌人喷吐闪电造成 %d 到 %d 伤害。
		伤害受意志加成。
items.source_evidence: gifts/summon-distance.lua:226-232 info tformat(damDesc(LIGHTNING, combatTalentStatDamage(t,'wil',30,500)/3), damDesc(LIGHTNING, combatTalentStatDamage(t,'wil',30,500))); action rolls rng.avg(dam/3, dam, 3); range 5, single target
items.note: Low and high bounds come from one getter with the low bound divided by three, and the target preserves low-to-high order. The added 单体 is consistent with the single-target hit at range 5, and the Willpower clause matches the 'wil' argument.

items.source:
Insert a pair of gems into your golem, providing it with the gem bonuses and changing its melee attack damage type. You may remove the gems and insert different ones; this does not destroy the gems you remove.
		Gem level usable: %d
		Gem changing is done in the golem's inventory.
items.target:
在傀儡身上镶嵌 2 颗宝石，它可以得到宝石加成并改变近战攻击类型。你可以移除并镶嵌不同种类的宝石，移除行为不会破坏宝石。
		可用宝石等级： %d
		宝石会在傀儡的物品栏中改变成功。
items.source_evidence: spells/advanced-golemancy.lua:70-74 info tformat(self:getTalentLevelRaw(t)), single %d for usable gem level; the pair is enforced by golemancy.lua body GEM={max=2} and canWearObjectCustom gates material_level against getTalentLevelRaw
items.note: Placeholder and the rendering of 'a pair' as 2 颗 are both correct against the body slot limit. Defect is the closing line: the source instructs the player where gem swapping happens, while the target asserts that gems 会在傀儡的物品栏中改变成功, which reads as a claim about success rather than an instruction and loses the actionable direction.
items.proposed_target: 宝石的更换在傀儡的物品栏中进行。

items.source:
Echoes of the future flash before your eyes, allowing you to sense some incoming attacks.
		If the attack is not physical, you will erect a temporary shield that reduces all damage of this type by %d%% for 5 turns.
		This effect can only happen once every 5 turns, and happens before damage is taken.
		The bonus will increase with your Spellpower.
items.target:
你的眼前会闪烁未来的景象，让你能够预知对你的攻击。
		如果攻击造成的不是物理伤害，你会创造一道临时护盾，使此类伤害降低 %d%%，持续 5 回合。
		此效果每隔 5 回合只能触发一次，且在承受伤害前被激活。
		效果受法术强度加成。
items.source_evidence: spells/divination.lua:143-149 info tformat(resist); getResist:126 = 10 + combatTalentSpellDamage(t,2,25); shield applied at :131 setEffect(EFF_PREMONITION_SHIELD, 5, ...) and gated at :130 by `if not self:hasEffect(EFF_PREMONITION_SHIELD)`; non-physical precondition is an early return on damtype
items.note: Both 5-turn figures are the same literal and the target keeps both. The once-every-5-turns limit is the shield effect's own duration acting as the gate rather than a talent cooldown, which the target's 每隔 5 回合只能触发一次 conveys correctly, as does 在承受伤害前被激活 for the pre-damage timing.

items.source: You know how to hit the right places, gaining +%d%% critical damage modifier and %d armour penetration.
items.target: 你知道如何击中目标弱点，使你获得 +%d%% 暴击伤害加成和 %d 护甲穿透。
items.source_evidence: techniques/thuggery.lua:111-113 info tformat(t.critpower(self,t), t.getAPR(self,t)); critpower:105 combatTalentScale(t,6,25) applied to combat_critical_power; getAPR:106 combatTalentScale(t,5,20) applied to combat_apr
items.note: Two distinct getters feeding two placeholders, and the target keeps critical damage before armour penetration in the same order as the passives assign them.

items.source: Your Block talent now lasts for 2 game turns and you can apply Counterstrike to any number of enemies.
items.target: 你的格挡技能持续时间 2 回合，并且你可以反击任意数量的敌人。
items.source_evidence: uber/const.lua:71-74 info has an empty tformat(), so '2 game turns' is a literal; Block sets EFF_BLOCKING duration 2 in misc/objects.lua:321, the dagger variant uses 1+(Eternal Guard and 1 or 0); physical.lua:2358 skips setting eff.did_counterstrike when Eternal Guard is known, which is what makes Counterstrike unlimited
items.note: Counterstrike as 反击 matches the corpus (7 of 7). Defect is the turn unit: the source says '2 game turns' and the target renders 2 回合, dropping a qualifier ToME treats as mechanically distinct from player turns. The corpus convention is 游戏回合 (9 occurrences against 3 bare 回合).
items.proposed_target: 你的格挡技能持续时间 2 游戏回合，并且你可以反击任意数量的敌人。

items.source:
Surround yourself with a malevolent aura that stores damage you deal.
		Whenever you have stored %d damage of one type you unleash a powerful blast at a random enemy dealing %d damage of that type in radius %d and applying one of the following effects:

		Physical:		Slows combat, mind, and spell speed by 20%%.
		#GREEN#Acid:#LAST#  Deals %d acid damage each turn for 5 turns (%d total).
		#DARK_GREEN#Blight:#LAST#  Deals %d blight damage each turn for 5 turns and reduces strength, constitution, and dexterity by %d.
		#GREY#Darkness:#LAST#  Reduces damage dealt by %d%% for 5 turns.
		#LIGHT_STEEL_BLUE#Temporal:#LAST#  Slows global action speed by %d%% for 5 turns.
		#ORANGE#Mind:#LAST#  Confuses (power %d%%) for 5 turns.

		Each effect can only happen once per 10 player turns.  This does not count as a typical cooldown.
		The damage and effect power increase with your Cunning, the threshold with your level, and the apply power is the highest of your mind or spell power.
		%s
items.target:
你被灾厄光环笼罩，存储你造成的伤害。
		当你积累的某类伤害达到 %d 时，你会向一个随机的敌人发射一次强力的爆炸，造成 %d 的该类型伤害，爆炸半径 %d 码，并对其中的敌人附加以下的附加效果：
		物理：降低 20%% 攻击、施法和精神速度
		#GREEN#酸性 :#LAST#  每回合受到 %d 酸性伤害，持续 5 回合(总计 %d)。
		#DARK_GREEN#枯萎 :#LAST#  每回合受到 %d 枯萎伤害，力量、体质和敏捷减少 %d ，持续 5 回合
		#GREY#黑暗 :#LAST#  造成的所有伤害减少 %d%%，持续 5 回合。
		#LIGHT_STEEL_BLUE#时空 :#LAST#  全局速度降低 %d%%，持续 5 回合。
		#ORANGE#精神 :#LAST#  混乱 (强度 %d%% ) ，持续 5 回合。
		同种效果最多每 10 回合触发一次。这不是普通的技能冷却。
		伤害和效果强度受灵巧值加成，伤害阈值受等级加成，施加附加效果的强度由你的精神强度和法术强度的最高值决定。
		%s
items.source_evidence: uber/cun.lua:180-206 info, tformat at :205 with 11 arguments in order: getThreshold, getDamage, getTalentRadius, damDesc(ACID, getAcid), damDesc(ACID, getAcid*5), blight_dam, blight_disease, getDarkness, getTemporal, getMind, str; getBlight:97-99 returns two values which supply arguments 6 and 7; getMind:103 is bounded 0-50; the 20%% slow, every 'for 5 turns' and the 10-turn proc gate are literals, with setProc(...,true,10) counting player turns
items.note: All eleven arguments are in the correct order, including the acid per-turn and 5-turn total being separate arguments over the same getter, and 灵巧 for Cunning matches terminology/combat.tsv:118. Defect is presentation and units: eight spacing errors (a space before the half-width colon in each of the five markup labels, a space before two full-width commas, a space after an opening parenthesis), plus 'once per 10 player turns' rendered as 每 10 回合, dropping the player-turn qualifier the same way item 23 drops the game-turn one.
items.proposed_target: Fix spacing: use full-width colons directly after the five markup labels with no leading space, remove the spaces before 造成的 commas and inside the confusion parenthesis, and render the gate as 每 10 玩家回合.
